query.text: 请帮我照看这只狗，如果发现它有什么不舒服或异常行为请提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after this dog, and alert me if you notice any discomfort or abnormal behavior.

annotation.text_zh: 频繁挠耳朵可能是耳朵痒，建议检查一下耳道。
annotation.text_en: Scratching their ears a lot might mean they're itchy; you should check their ears.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
